note: The curated half of docs/go-migration-matrix.md's v2 status table. The executing-language column is NOT in this file: it is read at render time from contracts/native-families/v1/native-families.json, the Go-emitted AST-derived authority, so no hand-typed value can disagree with what the worker actually wires. Everything here is a claim a human made, and internal/migrationmatrix's validators refuse any claim whose evidence cell is empty -- parity.status "verified" without a ticket, a 40-hex sha AND an evidence path fails CI. Keys are "<scope>/<family>" because family names are not unique across scopes (work_item_attribution exists in both daily and remaining and means two different executors). parity.status starts at "unverified" for every family: that is the true state, and it is the state the old one-column matrix had no way to express.
